definitions.explanation: A heavy, weighing-down pressure, usually figurative — the strain of responsibility, expectation, or a difficult situation. More literary and forceful than the everyday loanword プレッシャー.

examples.japanese: {重圧|じゅうあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重圧|じゅうあつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}しつぶされそうだ。
examples.english: I feel almost crushed by the weight of responsibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{期待|きたい}される→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧{重圧|じゅうあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: Under the crushing pressure of being expected to win the championship, he fought well.

notes:
{重圧|じゅうあつ} combines {重|じゅう} (heavy) and {圧|あつ} (pressure); it reads as a stronger, more formal word than プレッシャー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重圧|じゅうあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel heavy pressure
- {重圧|じゅうあつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to withstand crushing pressure
- {重圧|じゅうあつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}しつぶされる→押しつぶす：12785_oshitsubusu⟧: to be crushed by the pressure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プレッシャー: pressure — the everyday, more casual word
- {重圧|じゅうあつ}: heavier, more literary; often used for institutional, historical, or life-defining strain
